note: Music tab model registry (docs/MUSIC.md). One entry per swappable model; the dropdown offers only entries that opensoul/music/registry.py lets through: enabled, status confirmed, confirmed_by set, licence allowed by license_allowlist / license_rules, every spec filled in and a runner (a comfyui runner needs a workflow file that exists), and a pinned revision for anything that isn't OpenSoul's own code. Licences and revisions come from a licence check written down in docs/MUSIC.md; nobody fills one in from memory. gpu_validated false = never run from the app on the GPU. preview_only entries exist only in preview mode (OPENSOUL_DRY_RUN): original synthetic audio, no model. runner.nodes maps the app's inputs to [node id, input name] in the API-format workflow, plus the output node id; opensoul/music/song.py applies them through opensoul.comfy_client.run_workflow_file like every other workflow. 'files' use the presets/models.yaml path rules.

gpu_gate.note: Studio mode only: before a song or stem job is queued, wait while a tmux session matching one of these globs runs (session names are only listed, never touched). mv_* = music-video renders.

license_rules.note: Contest licence policy. Allowed: license_allowlist. needs_credit: allowed only with a credit line ('credit'). needs_ai_label: allowed only on output that carries the AI-generated label (the model sets ai_label true). blocked: non-commercial, research-only, gated without redistribution, or no licence; never enabled. Anything else is undecided: off by default and listed by opensoul.music.registry.undecided() for review.

roles.song: Lyrics or a prompt in, a finished song (with or without vocals) out.
roles.stems: Optional vocal separation: a song in, a vocal stem and an instrumental stem out. Lip-sync uses the full mix by default, and the vocal stem only when the optional ACE-Step 1.5 XL base model is installed.
roles.analysis: Beats, bars and sections from an audio file.

models.name: OpenSoul beat finder (built in, CPU)
models.confirmed_by: OpenSoul source (this repo's own code, numpy only)
models.notes: Fallback and preview beat grid: spectral-flux onsets, autocorrelation tempo, dynamic-programming beats, bar phase, section novelty. Always available.

models.name: beat_this (CPJKU)
models.confirmed_by: docs/MUSIC.md (licence check, Oct 19 2026): 'The code and the published model weights are released under the MIT license'

runner.needs: beat_this + torch (studio env only) and a local 'final0' checkpoint file: env OPENSOUL_BEAT_THIS_CKPT or runner.checkpoint

models.notes: Preferred beat and downbeat grid in the studio. Imported only when installed (needs torch; never installed into the app's .venv). Loads a local checkpoint file only (sha256 checked, never auto-downloaded); without it, or with a different file, the built-in opensoul_onset tracker runs. Not run yet.

models.name: Preview song (no model)
models.confirmed_by: OpenSoul source (synthetic audio made by opensoul/music/song.py)
models.notes: Preview mode only. A click track whose bars follow the lyric sections, a soft hum on each lyric line as the stand-in vocal, and a matching LRC.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo
models.confirmed_by: docs/MUSIC.md (licence check, Oct 19 2026): MIT on the HF metadata of all weight repos and on the GitHub repo
models.credit: Music generated with ACE-Step 1.5 (ACE Studio & StepFun), MIT License, https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5
models.notes: Default song model. Native ComfyUI core nodes; workflow workflows/08m_song_acestep15_api.json (same graph as ComfyUI's ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo template); files: ./scripts/download_models.sh music (pinned, sha256-checked). VRAM: XL-turbo + 4B LM, no offload. NOT validated on the GPU from the app yet. Text-to-music from original lyrics only: no reference audio, cover or LoRA of real recordings. LRC lyric timestamps: the ACE-Step LM can write them; the ComfyUI core nodes' LRC output is not confirmed, so the app takes song.lrc when the runner provides one and estimates line times otherwise.

models.name: HeartMuLa-oss-3B
models.confirmed_by: docs/MUSIC.md (licence check, Oct 19 2026): Apache-2.0 on the HF metadata (3B, happy-new-year, HeartCodec) and on GitHub; licence changed to Apache-2.0 on 20 Jan 2026
models.notes: Second option. Weights pinned in 'revision' (Apache-2.0 at these revisions; older HeartMuLa-oss-3B revisions were CC-BY-NC-4.0, never use them). VRAM about 16 GB comes from the community node's README (unverified). Needs a custom node (not on workflows/node_allowlist.json yet) and an API workflow, so the dropdown shows it as not ready. Not validated on the GPU.

models.name: Preview vocal (the preview song's hum)
models.notes: Preview mode only: the hum written next to the preview song stands in for a separated vocal stem.

models.name: ACE-Step 1.5 XL base: extract (vocals)
models.confirmed_by: docs/MUSIC.md (licence check, Oct 19 2026): MIT on the acestep-v15-xl-base HF card and on the GitHub repo; extract runs on base models only

runner.needs: the ACE-Step 1.5 Python env with acestep-v15-xl-base (ACE_XL_BASE=1 ./scripts/download_models.sh music)

models.notes: Optional vocal separation. ACE-Step 1.5's 'extract' task runs only on the base / XL base models, not on the XL Turbo model the song step uses, so OpenSoul ships without stem separation by default and lip-sync uses the full mix. Weights: ACE-Step/acestep-v15-xl-base at the pinned revision (MIT, about 20 GB), off by default in the download group. Runner is a stub (opensoul/music/ace_extract.py); VRAM and max length are unknown. Untested until the GPU smoke.

models.name: Demucs (Hybrid Transformer)
models.notes: Blocked for the contest: the code is MIT but the pretrained weights are for research / personal use only (their training data, MUSDB18, is non-commercial). Kept here for the record; never offered, never enabled, never downloaded, not credited.
